review.name: Cinder Cub
findings: Original source all thirteen clips inspected at six phases: six standard full-face slices, six full-body slices and three extra opposite-head slices for the authored three-quarter sculpt orientation. Muzzle/lower face pulls relative to eye mask and skull during recoil and turned death; scarf crosses the lower face in the opposite head view. Gait and jump support are poorly coordinated; actual fire strike, breaker and signature windup visibly lift/flatten the body and the strike pushes its body forward off the platform with feet no longer supporting it. All 216 actual equipped-technique frames inspected in twelve native strips. Independent lower-face normalized drift peaks at 1.1303912311967308 in source and all nine patches are frozen independently before repair. Original battle and the other four starters animation/technique captures exist but no visual inspection of those captures is yet claimed. Four original visible paw surfaces, joint locations and actual forward direction must be checked before fitting a candidate.

Original fifteen source raw slices including opposite head side and all 216 actual technique frames inspected: jaw and ear shear, scarf crosses lower face in recoil, and attacks compress/lift forelegs and pitch the torso beyond support. Four-view visible soles and original joint picks frozen before fitting. V1 rejected independently for sole drift despite passing face and geometry probes; one V1 raw slice and zero V1 technique frames actually seen. V2 preserves sculpt, topology, textures, all 21 original bone frames/inverses and 172 unaffected curves while appending fourteen fitted leg/neck/head joints. Measured sculpt-forward direction is rotated relative to generic rig +Z and is applied consistently to all chains and action targets. All fifteen V2 raw slices and 216 actual technique frames inspected and pass; independent face passes 1878 clip poses plus 468 blends and full geometry 1591 poses has zero warnings. Fresh final source/battle and runtime second pass pending.

Final second pass: all thirty raw slices including the opposite head side, sixteen low runtime slices, sixteen fresh ink-fixed medium runtime slices, twenty-four advancing companion idle frames, all 216 fresh native equipped-technique frames, and all sixteen atlas cells visually inspected and pass. The first medium runtime attempt was rejected after eight source slices for inverted-hull leakage through the concave flame; its remaining eight battle slices were not inspected. Cinder-only outlineScale 1 removes the leakage; low preset already disables the hull, so its inspected captures and low companion/technique evidence remain applicable. Other identities retain their existing outline configuration.

candidateHistory.finding: Face and full geometry probes passed, but independently frozen visible sole surfaces moved up to .00170954 because leg smoothing reached sole vertices. Only head-front slice 1 was visually inspected. V2 restricts smoothing above the frozen sole surface.
